usedFor: A new Zoho CRM account sets up a brand in Eclincher for client social posting.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Create Brand” in Eclincher
bestTemplate.why: If you run social for each client, a new account becomes a brand ready for posts.

watchOut: Anything published later with “Create Post” reaches outside the business, so it waits for approval.
